name: mnemosyne-neural-os
description: MCP server and agent skill for Mnemosyne OS: gives your agent the vaults you choose in the desktop app, local memory searched by vector and BM25 on your own machine.

interface.shortDescription: Local memory vaults for your agent, on your machine
interface.longDescription: Connects your agent to Mnemosyne OS, a desktop memory app for Windows, macOS (Apple silicon) and Linux. Watched folders feed separate vaults on your machine; search fuses vector ranking with a local BM25 keyword channel. The agent reads only the vaults you grant; any other vault answers SCOPE_DENIED. The MCP server (@mnemosyne_os/mcp) and the skill in this repository are MIT; the memory tools need the free desktop app running, and its memory engine ships closed inside the desktop build.
defaultPrompt: List my Mnemosyne vaults and what each one is for.
Search my notes vault for what I decided about this module.
